title: Comparecencia del Ministro Delegado del Interior y Administración Local
publisher: Oficina de Información y Prensa de Guinea Ecuatorial
why: Q1: official source says many cities lack adequate street nomenclature, the Malabo and Bata study was left unfinished and a commission is still working; it says this hinders administration, cadastre and emergency response.

title: La Cámara de Diputados pide al Gobierno poner nombres a todas las calles de las ciudades
why: Q1: reports the Chamber of Deputies asking the government to name all streets; poor nomenclature affects transport and emergencies; Malabo and Bata study not concluded.

title: Equatorial Guinea
why: Q4: UPU addressing guide shows urban delivery by door reference with province, sub-province and locality, rural by locality, and PO boxes; no postcodes or national street register shown.

title: Las comisiones técnicas presentan sus informes ante la Primera Ministra
publisher: Oficina de Información y Prensa de Guinea Ecuatorial
why: Q2: commissions still examining draft laws on the national cadastre and property register, including rural land; preparatory work, not an address register in service.

title: El equipo gubernamental celebra su segundo Consejo Interministerial del 2024
publisher: Oficina de Información y Prensa de Guinea Ecuatorial
why: Q2: government analysing draft laws for a national land cadastre and property registration; land registers, not an address system.
